item.title: Gold rebounds to near $3,900 despite inflation worries
item.fxstnewsns:summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers some lost ground to near $3,895 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal edges higher after falling to its lowest level of $3,870 in the previous session.

item.title: WTI drops to near $101.00 amid OPEC+ quotas, Middle East diplomacy
item.fxstnewsns:summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price depreciates after three days of gains, trading around $101.20 per barrel during Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Fed’s Logan calls for two more rate hikes; pause won’t alter path
item.fxstnewsns:summary: On Friday, the Dallas Federal Reserve President Lorie Logan said that “at least two more quarter-point rate hikes” are needed. She added that skipping a hike “doesn’t change policy destination,” and that adjusting interest rates “gradually” reduces the risks of a sharp economic deterioration.

item.title: Ukraine resumes strikes on Russian oil refineries
item.fxstnewsns:summary: Ukraine has resumed its attacks on Russian oil refineries in defiance of pressure from US President Donald Trump ahead of the US midterm elections, ending a pause of about two weeks in such attacks, the Guardian reported on Sunday.

item.title: Ethereum Price Forecast: ETH drops near $2,200 after Binance hack
item.fxstnewsns:summary: Ethereum (ETH) drops toward $2,200 on Friday as the crypto market remains weighed down by the Binance hack and tech selloffs.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says joint FX statement with US persists, will act against disorderly moves
item.fxstnewsns:summary: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Monday that the Joint FX statement with the United States (US) persists and the government will act against disorderly moves.
